lines.say: What if you could watch a real processor think?
lines.show: What if you could watch a real processor think?

lines.say: This is Tiny C P U.
A real risk five processor, written in System Verilog, compiled to Web Assembly, running live in your browser.
lines.show: A real RISC-V processor, written in SystemVerilog, compiled to WebAssembly, running live in your browser.

lines.say: Pick a program, or write your own.
lines.show: Pick a program, or write your own.

lines.say: Hit assemble and run, and the hardware executes it.
lines.show: Hit assemble and run, and the hardware executes it.

lines.say: Watch five instructions share a five stage pipeline.
lines.show: Watch five instructions share a five-stage pipeline.

lines.say: Fetch. Decode. Execute. Memory. Write back.
Step through every cycle, and watch registers, memory, and output update live.
lines.show: Step through every cycle, and watch registers, memory, and output update live.

lines.say: When instructions collide, you see exactly why.
lines.show: When instructions collide, you see exactly why.

lines.say: Forwarding paths. Load-use stalls. Branch flushes.
lines.show: Forwarding paths. Load-use stalls. Branch flushes.

lines.say: Turn forwarding off, and watch the cycle count climb.
lines.show: Turn forwarding off, and watch the cycle count climb.

lines.say: Zoom into the datapath. Compare programs. Explore memory as a heat map.
lines.show: Zoom into the datapath. Compare programs. Explore memory as a heat map.

lines.say: Forty official risk five tests. Two hundred sixty random programs. All matched against a golden model.
lines.show: Forty official RISC-V tests. Two hundred sixty random programs. All matched against a golden model.

lines.say: It even fits on a real F P G A.
lines.show: It even fits on a real FPGA.

lines.say: Ready to look inside a computer?
lines.show: Ready to look inside a computer?

lines.say: Open Tiny C P U, right now, in your browser.
lines.show: Open TinyCPU, right now, in your browser.

lines.say: Your first clock cycle is waiting.
